primer: Arista Networks builds high-speed data center switches and single-code EOS software for cloud and AI clusters. Nine-month sales grew 44.3% YoY with a 44.4% operating margin and $14.36 billion in cash. Yet gross margin fell 160 bps to 62.9%, test gear doubled to $874.3 million, and NVIDIA won fresh Meta work. On November 20, ANET fell 11.57% to $167.66 ($167.62 in facts), breaking our $172.09 stop and forcing an immediate exit on all 39.599149 shares into cash. New capital is REJECTED on Valuation and Trend because ex-SBC diluted Base fair value ($180.00) leaves <1.50:1 R:R across every Stage 4 and 30-week reclaim entry path.
